name: goals-and-calendar
conversation: (in a Cowork project with a goals note: 'Q4 retention above 110%; get better at B2B sales; stop working after 22:00'. Calendar: Northwind pitch Thursday. Memory: liked a pricing teardown video, skipped two long podcasts. Web search on. Gmail not connected.)
expected_behavior: Searches the web and opens every candidate; YouTube links are checked with oEmbed
Top pick ties to the Thursday pitch and fits the 30-minute budget
Covers work, business and life across 3-5 cards, with at most one stretch card
Every because line cites a source in sources_checked (Project files, Google Calendar, Memory), and Gmail is listed as missing
adjusted names the shorter-picks change and cites Memory
deck.json passes validate_deck.py; the artifact is the template plus render_page.py --data, written once
Closes in two lines: sources read, and how to send feedback

name: feedback-pasted
conversation: (the next morning, in the same project)
query:
learn-today feedback 2026-10-23:
👍 1 Teardown: a B2B pitch that closed in one meeting (work, video)
👎 3 The two-minute wind-down (life, podcast)
Also the podcast was too slow.
expected_behavior: Saves the feedback with the reason ('too slow') before picking
Today's deck leans toward the liked creator or format and avoids slow podcasts
adjusted shows that change, citing You or Memory
Does not repeat any link from yesterday's deck

name: cold-start
conversation: (fresh chat, no memory, no connectors, web search on)
expected_behavior: Asks one line about goals in work, business and life, and nothing else
Builds the deck from the answer with because lines citing You
Says once that with no memory the deck starts fresh

name: no-web-search
query: What should I watch today to learn?
expected_behavior: Says it needs web search to find and verify links, and stops
Does not produce any link from memory or a guessed YouTube URL

name: scheduled-run
conversation: (a scheduled task in the project: 'Run learn-today for today. Lead with a five-line text list, then the deck.')
expected_behavior: Asks no questions
Leads with a short text list of title, format, minutes and link, then the deck
Saves the deck line to memory as the no-repeat history

name: dead-link
conversation: (a strong candidate video returns 404 from oEmbed)
expected_behavior: Drops the video and picks another verified one, without mentioning the dead one as a pick
If fewer than three verify, gives them as text and says why instead of padding

name: schedule-it
conversation: (a deck was just shown inside a project)
expected_behavior: Proposes one message: daily 07:00, auto-approve, the instruction, any non-default settings
Creates it only after a yes, and never claims it is scheduled without seeing it created
